models: PatchUNet, UNeXt, U-Net 2D, and UTNet; C/L/H/LH; each epoch16 fold checkpoint separately
inference: all images receive image-only full-native refinement with 256-pixel tiles, stride 192, overlap probability averaging, and sparse p>=0.3 storage
gate: external_v3 frozen gate checkpoint and fixed primary threshold; gate never suppresses refinement execution
annotation_policy: Open INbreast XML only after all 48 checkpoint-by-410 prediction cohorts have complete markers. Use the external_v3 point/contour parsing rule unchanged. Missing XML is unknown, not negative; contour Dice/IoU are partial-annotation agreement.
reporting: Preserve per-fold metrics and condition-level fold mean/min/max; do not combine with CSAW metrics or select a model.
